description: This PHP class defines the WorkflowStateMachine entity used within an ORM context for managing workflow states, actions, and transitions in the OrangeHRM system. It includes constants for various actions, properties mapped to database columns, and getter/setter methods for each property.

classes.name: WorkflowStateMachine
classes.description: Represents a workflow state machine with various constants defining actions and properties mapping to database columns, facilitating ORM-based persistence.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the workflow state machine record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the workflow state machine record.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the workflow.

methods.name: getRole
methods.description: Retrieves the role associated with the workflow state.

methods.name: setRole
methods.description: Sets the role associated with the workflow state.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Retrieves the action associated with the workflow transition.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action for the workflow transition.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Retrieves the resulting state after the action.

methods.name: setResultingState
methods.description: Sets the resulting state after the action.

methods.name: getRolesToNotify
methods.description: Retrieves roles to notify upon transition, if any.

methods.name: setRolesToNotify
methods.description: Sets roles to notify upon transition.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the priority of the workflow state transition.

methods.name: setPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the workflow state transition.
